title: This Is for Everyone
description: The inventor of the World Wide Web explores his vision’s promise - and how it can be redeemed for the future. This audiobook is read by award-winning comedian, actor, presenter and director, Sir Stephen Fry. It also includes a bonus conversation between the author and narrator.Narrator Stephen Fry’s plummy voice and English accent, combined with his enthusiasm for his topic, make him the perfect narrator.
